# Britannica Curiosity Compass

> > Britannica's interactive personality quiz that identifies your curiosity type through the science of curiosity, connecting you with famous figures like Marie Curie, Mae Jemison, and Albert Einstein.

The Curiosity Compass is Britannica's educational platform exploring curiosity science and neuroscience through personality assessment. It helps users discover whether they're a Scientist, Explorer, Inventor, or other curiosity archetype, while learning about famous scientists, STEM careers, and self-discovery.

## Curiosity Compass Hub

- [Britannica's Curiosity Compass](https://curiosity.britannica.com/): Main hub for the Curiosity Compass personality quiz and exploration of curiosity science

## Curiosity Personality Types

- [Scientist Personality Profile](https://curiosity.britannica.com/scientist): Discover the Scientist curiosity type: characteristics, famous scientists, and career paths
- [Explorer Personality Profile](https://curiosity.britannica.com/explorer): Discover the Explorer curiosity type: characteristics, notable explorers, and discovery archetypes
- [Inventor Personality Profile](https://curiosity.britannica.com/inventor): Discover the Inventor curiosity type: characteristics, famous inventors, and innovation pathways
